pages.title: Welcome
pages.content:
A small index of AI-generated experiments — each one a self-contained HTML page built iteratively with an AI assistant.

This site is the record. The content lives in a single `content.json` file with embedded page templates and markdown; this page renders it as a lab notebook. Enjoy.

pages.title: About
pages.content:
All code on this site was generated iteratively with AI assistance — OpenAI free plan (reasoning enabled), Copilot free in VS Code, and Grok (Super Grok plan).

The site itself is a single self-contained page: no build step, no frameworks, no CDN links — just one HTML file reading one JSON file.
